name: m4-devirt-sym-ab
description: Timing A/B for devirtualising `Symbol.isClass` / `isPackageClass` / `isRefinementClass` / `info` / `rawInfo` (draft [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199)) against its base, the `scala2-perf-integration` tip `00e3bbafb8`. The profile campaign `m4-devirt-sym-prof` showed the vtable stubs at the targeted call sites gone and 6% fewer compiler-thread instructions in one fork per build.

Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), 8G heap, no profiler. Builds alternate fork by fork over 5 rounds; scala: single-shot 4+4 ops; scalap: 20+20 x 2 s.

variantDescriptions.proto: retronym/scala#199: final kind predicates (type checks + raw PACKAGE bit) and final `info`/`rawInfo`
